measurementQualification: Controlled workload results are synthetic. Representative late-game results require a separate representative checkpoint; do not relabel controlled fleet spawns as late-game evidence.
baseline: Private local inventory .tmp/issue-completion-gates/profiling/local-game-baseline.json records 114 enabled mods and 31 existing save directories. No original saves or mod settings have been changed.
preservation: Before changing mods, back up enabled_mods.json and record its hash, each active mod version and the game/JRE version. Restore the original configuration after experiments.
Preserve original save directories. Create new disposable campaigns and use an unmistakable NF-PROFILE checkpoint prefix.
Record the exact active mod set for each checkpoint. Never load an incompatible checkpoint for comparison.

campaign.setup: New disposable campaign; normal game speed 1x, paused for all Console Commands setup. Select a fixed system and camera position. Start with idle workload; create a separate stress checkpoint if fleets are spawned.
campaign.stressCommandReference: Installed Console Commands 4.0.9 commands.csv: spawnfleet <faction> <combatFP> [optionalName]. Verify faction and record successful fleet counts before saving; spawned compositions do not represent vanilla doctrines.
campaign.route: Reload the prepared checkpoint before every run. Close console and overlays, restore the documented camera, unpause at 1x. Keep player fleet stationary and perform no console setup during capture.
campaign.duration: 30 seconds warm-up followed by 120 seconds capture, five independent reloads for each instrumentation setting.

combat.setup: Prepare a separate compatible disposable checkpoint and a documented fixed fleet/encounter setup. Record deployment, simulation seed where available, speed, pause state and autopilot settings.
combat.route: Reload before each run; repeat the same encounter and deployment route. Complete console setup before unpausing and measuring.
combat.duration: 30 seconds warm-up plus 120 seconds capture, five independent reloads per setting.

comparison: Pair instrumentation-disabled and instrumentation-enabled runs against the same compatible scenario. Record scheduling order, game/JRE/build/mod hashes and capture settings. Keep callback spans separate from whole-frame evidence.
currentLimitations: Computer-control initialization fails in Codex sandbox setup with Windows OS32 on node_repl.exe; no game interaction has occurred.

Licensed API fixtures verify observer registration, pre-save removal and resumed collection after save. Actual game lifecycle/scheduling, save serialization, whole-frame boundaries, instrumentation overhead and representative late-game measurements remain unverified.
